used_split: train_real only; original official training sequences
local_split: Eight complete training scenes for fitting, two disjoint official-training scenes for validation; sampled frames using fixed linspace before downstream fitting
exclude: No BOP test images; no original 80K YCB synthetic images (official BOP warns their test-pose overlap); no current pallet evaluation files read or used for selection
mask_visible: Binary visible part of object silhouette. Instance index matches scene_gt JSON list, not object ID.
mask_full: Binary silhouette of target in isolation including portions hidden by other objects, clipped to image domain. Full mask is not all self-hidden surfaces.
external_label: mask_full==255 and mask_visib==0 is external occlusion proxy derived from official rendered silhouette/depth mask; mask_full==0 is outside target support and never relabeled occlusion.
self_label: Unknown from 2D full/visible masks; require known surface/keypoint semantic geometry for self occlusion.
uncertainty: Boundary masks and rendered mesh/pose alignment can disagree with real RGB by a few pixels; preserve explicit boundary/transition handling.
annotations: Use provided ground-truth poses/K only as training metadata; no PnP or pose optimization invoked.
annotation_integrity_note: All 4200 selected instances: official scene_gt_info differs from CRC-verified mask raster pixel counts in 105 field comparisons, maximum absolute difference 2 pixels; raw masks retained.
train_split_primary_evidence: official_dataset_info.txt explicitly states train_real uses original YCB_Video_Dataset/image_sets/train.txt
